items.title: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
items.description: Nova Lake desktop CPUs look to be the exclusive recipient of bLLC, Intel's answer to AMD's X3D, as the company looks to debut bLLC on mobile with Razor Lake-HX, and possibly Razor Lake-AX. As such, the Razor Lake family is also rumored to be manufactured on TSCM's N2X process node.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Recent updates Update 18 Aug 12pm ET: Jaykihn has since revised his information regarding Razor Lake's node, stating it will be N2P V2, not N2X. Intel's upcoming, next-gen Nova Lake CPUs are rumored to feature extra pools of L3 cache that the company is calling bLLC (Big Last Level Cache). It's Intel's answer to AMD's 3D V-Cache that has taken the gaming world by storm, but a new report from tipster Jaykihn implies that Nova Lake mobile chips will be skipping it entirely. Instead, the company is purportedly reserving bLLC's mobile debut for the generation after, codenamed Razor Lake.Razor Lake will come with bLLC mobile SKUs.August 18, 2026That implies that only Nova Lake desktop processors will be the lucky recipients of bLLC, and even then, only a few higher-end SKUs are expected to feature it. Current rumors suggest a single NVL-S tile is said to house 144MB of bLLC when fully equipped, so dual-tile variants will double that to a whopping 288MB. But it seems like any laptop chip, or perhaps handheld, will be starved of this extra cache and rely on NVL-HX's native L3 cache.In contrast, AMD first brought its 3D V-Cache over to laptops with the Ryzen 9 7945HX3D back in 2023, and has a Ryzen 9 9995HX3D chip today. Those two act as exceptions because, otherwise, the Red Team's additional cache is exclusive to desktops as well. AMD's flagship Strix Halo products aimed at gaming don't feature it either. Coincidentally, Intel's Halo-tier competitor is also said to debut with the Razor Lake family.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Earlier this year, rumors suggested that Intel is developing Nova Lake-AX to take on AMD's dominance in the high-end APU space, but the project was subsequently cancelled. New information said Intel decided to pivot to Razor Lake for an "AX" category instead, so it stands to reason we might see bLLC power Razor Lake-AX SKUs later as well, alongside the mainstream Razor Lake-HX chips.In the same thread, Jaykihn also claimed that Razor Lake will be fabricated on TSMC's N2X node across mobile and desktop. On the other hand, it's still unclear whether Nova Lake would use the in-house 18A process or TSMC's N2P. Initial rumors pointed toward yield issues forcing Intel to leverage TSMC's technology, but more recent claims suggest the company is confident in its own 18A tech for most of Nova Lake's tiles. You may like Intel reportedly adding two new 22-core SKUs with game-boosting cache to Nova Lake-S lineup Nova Lake CPUs with cut-down E-core clusters may still retain full cache pool, says new leak Intel reportedly no longer working on 6-core Nova Lake mobile SKU, alleges new rumor N2XAugust 18, 2026It's likely that the Blue Team will utilize some combination of in-house and outsourced fabrication. Anyhow, for Razor Lake, TSMC's process technology roadmap from earlier this year puts N2X in 2027, so the timelines align. Razor Lake is expected to use the same Coyote Cove P-cores and Arctic Wolf E-cores that will be introduced on Nova Lake, while the generation after — Titan Lake — is rumored to finally unify the two. items.titleZh: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
items.descriptionZh:
英特尔下一代Nova Lake处理器将引入一项名为“bLLC”（Big Last Level Cache，大型末级缓存）的新技术，被视为对AMD 3D V-Cache的直接回应。然而，根据知名爆料人Jaykihn的最新消息，这项缓存增强技术在移动端的首秀将被推迟到下一代Razor Lake，Nova Lake移动芯片将完全无缘bLLC。

bLLC将首先出现在Nova Lake桌面处理器上，但仅限少数高端SKU。据传，单个NVL-S芯片区块（tile）在满配状态下可容纳144MB的bLLC，而双区块版本将翻倍至惊人的288MB。相比之下，笔记本或掌机芯片（NVL-HX）将只能依赖原生L3缓存，无法享受这一额外容量。

这一策略与AMD形成鲜明对比。AMD早在2023年就通过Ryzen 9 7945HX3D将3D V-Cache带到了笔记本电脑上，如今又推出了Ryzen 9 9995HX3D。不过这两款均属特例，大多数情况下AMD的额外缓存同样是桌面端独占，其面向游戏的旗舰Strix Halo系列也没有配备该特性。有趣的是，英特尔的Halo级竞品也计划在Razor Lake家族中首次亮相，这或许暗示bLLC未来将服务于Razor Lake-AX和Razor Lake-HX等高端移动芯片。

此前的传闻提到，英特尔曾计划开发Nova Lake-AX来对抗AMD在高端APU市场的统治地位，但该项目已取消。最新的信息显示，英特尔转而将Razor Lake作为“AX”类别的承载者，因此bLLC很有可能会随同Razor Lake-AX一起登场，同时覆盖主流的Razor Lake-HX。

关于制程节点，Razor Lake原传闻将采用台积电N2X工艺，但Jaykihn随后修订了这一说法，称其实际为N2P V2。至于Nova Lake，目前仍不清楚它将使用英特尔自家18A工艺还是台积电N2P。初期爆料指向良品率问题迫使英特尔依赖台积电，但较新的说法则认为英特尔对自家18A技术在Nova Lake大部分区块上的应用充满信心，最终很可能是自研与外包混用的局面。台积电此前公布的路线图显示N2X位于2027年，与Razor Lake的发布时间线相符。

架构方面，Razor Lake预计沿用Nova Lake首发的Coyote Cove性能核和Arctic Wolf能效核，而再下一代Titan Lake则传闻将首次统一这两种核心架构。这表明英特尔正在逐步推进其缓存与处理器架构布局，但移动端玩家想要体验到bLLC带来的性能提升，恐怕还需要再等一代产品。

items.title: AMD claims its 2026 rack-scale AI solution is 4X more energy efficient than its 2024 AI platform — company says it's pacing ahead of 20X efficiency by 2030
items.description: AMD says its 2025 rack-scale AI system is 4X more energy efficient compared to its 2024 AI solution, though does not produce actual benchmark results.
items.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter In addition to its normal product and technology roadmaps, AMD has effectively made its 'X-by-year' efficiency programs a recurring engineering roadmap. Back in 2025, the company unveiled its 20x2030 initiative that promised to increase energy efficiency of its rack-scale AI solutions 20 times by 2030. Back then, AMD envisioned that its 2026 rack-scale AI systems will be 3X more energy efficient than its 2024 machines. However, the new estimates published on Tuesday indicate that its latest solutions are 4X more efficient compared to the 2024 baseline.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleAMD estimates its progress at the rack level rather than on the CPU and AI accelerator levels, which obviously gives the company a lot of freedom in how to optimize performance efficiency. The company takes into account improvements in compute performance, process technology, memory bandwidth, data movement, interconnects, software, and system-level co-design. AMD says three major hardware characteristics determine AI system performance: compute capability, memory bandwidth, and interconnect bandwidth. New process technologies and architectures increase floating-point performance per watt, while improvements in memory integration and high-speed interconnects increase bandwidth available to processors. AMD expects these developments together to produce 20X higher AI performance per watt in 2030 compared to its 2024 baseline.Memory and interconnects play particularly important roles because modern AI systems tend to move enormous amounts of data between accelerators and systems. AMD says higher memory bandwidth, greater bandwidth density, improved bandwidth per watt, larger caches, and tighter integration of memory and compute can reduce wasted energy consumption and increase performance efficiency. Meanwhile, faster scale-up interconnects can improve communication between GPUs, CPUs, and other components, which again increases performance efficiency. AMD's software optimizations are another part of the effort as higher performance achieved with optimizations ultimately means lower power consumption required to achieve an expected result.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: What is a bit upsetting is that the 4X figure should be treated as an AMD estimate rather than a direct benchmark between two commercially available rack systems. AMD measures progress by comparing annual representative rack configurations with a 2024 baseline using the company's performance-per-watt methodology. In addition, its 2026 calculation combines measurements from actual products with modeled results in cases where final performance numbers were unavailable, which essentially means that AMD does not use its latest Instinct MI455X accelerators for its estimates.If AMD reaches its 2030 targets, the company estimates that around two AMD racks in 2030 could provide the same amount of compute as 570 racks based on the Instinct MI300X from 2024. This essentially means a 20X lower power consumption or 20X higher performance at the same power consumption by 2030. items.titleZh: AMD claims its 2026 rack-scale AI solution is 4X more energy efficient than its 2024 AI platform — company says it's pacing ahead of 20X efficiency by 2030
items.descriptionZh:
AMD的能效提升计划正从承诺走向现实。早在2025年，AMD就公布了“20x2030”倡议，目标是在2030年前将机架级AI解决方案的能源效率较2024年基线提升20倍。当时，AMD预计其2026年的机架级AI系统能效将是2024年的3倍，但本周二（2026年）发布的最新估算显示，这一数字已提升至4倍——比原计划提前超额完成了年度目标。

这一进展并非单纯依赖CPU或AI加速器单点性能的突破，而是AMD在机架级层面进行系统化协同设计的结果。AMD的能效评估涵盖了计算性能、制程工艺、内存带宽、数据搬移效率、互连技术、软件优化以及系统级协同设计等多个维度。该公司认为，AI系统性能由三大硬件特性决定：计算能力、内存带宽和互连带宽。新制程与架构持续提升每瓦浮点性能，而内存集成度和高速互连的改进则增加了处理器可用的带宽。尤其在AI工作负载中，加速器与系统之间需要搬运海量数据，更高的内存带宽、更大的缓存、更紧密的内存-计算集成，以及更优秀的每瓦带宽表现，都能有效减少能耗浪费、提升性能效率。同时，更快的scale-up互连改善了GPU、CPU及其他组件间的通信，进一步提高了整体能效。此外，AMD还将软件优化视为关键一环——通过软件调优获得更高性能，本质上意味着完成同等任务所需功耗更低。

不过，对于这“4倍”的数字需要保持审慎。AMD强调，这是基于其每瓦性能方法论的估算，而非两款市售机架系统间的直接基准测试。其方法是将年度代表性机架配置与2024年基线进行对比，且2026年的数据结合了实际产品测量与部分建模结果——在最终性能数据尚未出炉的情况下，AMD并未将最新的Instinct MI455X加速器纳入本次估算。

若AMD能如期达成2030年目标，其影响将是颠覆性的：届时大约2个AMD机架就能提供相当于570个基于Instinct MI300X（2024年产品）机架的计算能力。这意味着相较2024年，要么功耗降低至1/20，要么在同等功耗下实现20倍性能提升。对于大型数据中心运营方和AI算力需求方而言，这不仅是能效账本上的数字变化，更将深刻影响AI基础设施的规模、成本与可持续性——从电力成本到散热设计，从数据中心占地到碳排放，都将迎来新的可能性。

items.title: China's homegrown AI accelerators to supply 90% of the country's domestic market, analysts suggest — Cambricon and Huawei expected to be the biggest winners in the shift away from Nvidia and AMD
items.description: China could become almost self-sufficient in high-end AI accelerators in 2026 as Chinese IHVs led by Huawei expected to supply 90% of AI processors used domestically.
items.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Chinese AI accelerators are set to capture 90% of the country's domestic market as U.S. export controls and Beijing mandates push American-made hardware from AMD and Nvidia out of the market, according to a new report by TrendForce. Cambricon and Huawei are expected to be the biggest beneficiaries of the shift, according to DigiTimes. Yet, the big question is whether Chinese vendors can ship enough AI accelerators to satisfy demand.China on track for AI accelerator self-sufficiencyNvidia commanded 66% of China's AI accelerator market in 2024, but its share dropped to 40% in 2025 and was on track to drop to 8% in 2026, according to estimates made by Bernstein investment bank earlier this year. Considering the fact that Nvidia did not officially ship any new accelerators to Chinese clients in the first half of the year, Nvidia's chief executive Jensen Huang said in May that his company's market share in the PRC was 'zero.' Of course, some Nvidia GPUs make it to China 'unofficially' as local companies are too dependent on Nvidia's CUDA and high-end AI accelerators. Still, it is safe to say that the bulk of new deployments in the PRC are based on hardware designed and produced domestically. (Image credit: Nvidia)China's total available market of AI accelerators topped 4 million units in 2025, according to numbers published by Guancha.cn. Last year, 2.2 million Nvidia AI GPUs made it to the Chinese market, and while Nvidia's market share shrank to 55%, it still significantly outperformed its closest rival, Huawei, which shipped 812,000 AI accelerators and commanded 20.3% of the market.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Shipments by other players were by far lower: Alibaba's T-Head produced 265,000 AI accelerators, followed by AMD with 160,000. Cambricon and Kunlunxin only supplied around 116,000 AI processors each, whereas others shipped fewer than 100,000 units. Swipe to scroll horizontally AI accelerators market shares in 2025, data by TrendForce Company Shipment (10K units) Market Share NVIDIA 220 55.0% Huawei 81.2 20.3% T-Head 26.5 6.6% AMD 16 4.0% Kunlunxin 11.6 2.9% Cambricon 11.6 2.9% Hygon 8.3 2.1% MetaX 6.6 1.7% Iluvatar CoreX 4.9 1.2% Other 13.3 3.0% TOTAL 400 ~100% "This year, the Chinese government has actively encouraged the adoption of domestic AI chips," the report from TrendForce reads. "This policy push will likely provide priority support to high-potential domestic players, allowing them to substantially expand their market share in China's high-end AI server market. At the same time, the domestic ecosystem is maturing in key areas such as advanced foundry nodes, advanced packaging, and thermal management." You may like China adds homegrown AI chips to 'secure and reliable' procurement list for the first time China’s Huawei to enter South Korean AI chip market with new Atlas SuperPods, clusters pack 8,192 Ascend 950 accelerators per deployment China drafts $295 billion plan to build national AI data center grid running on 80% homemade silicon The firm now expects shipments of high-end AI processors developed by Chinese companies to increase by more than 83% year-over-year in 2026 as domestic production capacity and deployments expand. As a result, its analysts project domestic AI accelerators to capture nearly 90% of sales (up from 45% last year), which means that foreign suppliers like AMD and Nvidia will be left with roughly 10%. This latest projection represents a major revision from the research firm's December 2025 outlook, which estimated that Chinese processors would account for approximately 50% of China’s high-end AI chip market in 2026.Dual-track strategyAs AMD and Nvidia supplied some 2.36 million AI accelerators to the Chinese market last year, commanding a 59% unit share, replacing the majority of them will take a lot of effort, assuming that the TAM will remain at around 4 million units. TrendForce claims that China is set to adopt the so-called dual-track strategy, which involves AI accelerators from merchant suppliers like Huawei and Cambricon along with custom AI ASICs from Alibaba, Baidu, ByteDance, and Tencent. (Image credit: Biren Technology)"Together, these developments are moving China's AI infrastructure away from its heavy reliance on foreign GPUs, toward a dual-track model of 'domestic GPUs + proprietary ASICs,'" the firm claims.Hyperscale cloud service providers (CSPs) are inclined to expand usage of their own silicon because it is cheaper compared to merchant accelerators and because it is optimized for their workloads and data formats. Meanwhile, developers of merchant AI hardware — such as Huawei, Biren, and Cambricon — will also gradually expand their output of accelerators as demand is very strong.BottlenecksIt remains to be seen whether the Chinese chipmaking industry can indeed replace 1.96 million high-end AI accelerators in just one year. To maintain the 4 million unit TAM, China's semiconductor industry will need to increase AI accelerator output by 2.2X in just one year. What to read next China's Moonshot AI reportedly used Nvidia Blackwell chips for training Kimi K3 Qualcomm plans China-specific data center chips — new Dragonfly lineup will include nerfed AI accelerators that comply with export thresholds While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market (Image credit: SMIC)SMIC — China's largest and most advanced foundry — this week announced that its Q2 2026 revenue increased to $3.005 billion, up from $2.505 billion in Q1 2026, and from $2.209 billion in Q2 2025. This suggests that the company is both increasing the output of chips and its prices. However, it remains to be seen whether SMIC's 36% YoY revenue increase is an indicator that it can increase output of high-end AI accelerators by over 2X compared to 2025.Another major bottleneck for the Chinese industry is the lack of domestic production of high-bandwidth memory (HBM). Huawei has reportedly acquired plenty of HBM2-class memory from Samsung, but its stock is not endless, so its Ascend 950-series AI accelerators are set to rely on proprietary HiBL 1.0 and HiZQ 2.0 types of memory, not industry-standard HBM2 or HBM3. While China's DRAM champion CXMT is gearing up for HBM3 manufacturing in late 2026, it remains to be seen how quickly the company can ramp up production to decent levels.Nvidia's CUDA software stack is the company's biggest advantage after the performance and versatility of its AI accelerators. But while performance can be matched with brute force, the software stack cannot be reproduced quickly. Last year, Huawei opened up its CANN software stack to accelerate its development, though we do not know if the company has achieved its targeted goals with this. Yet, without a doubt, China's AI software stack is getting more mature every year, so many new AI deployments may indeed rely on domestic stacks rather than on CUDA.A shifting marketU.S. restrictions on exports of advanced AI accelerators, combined with China's own efforts to limit the use of American AI processors domestically, have largely pushed companies like AMD and Nvidia out of the Chinese market. Analysts now expect China-based independent hardware vendors to control 90% of the domestic AI accelerator market in 2026.Chinese AI hardware has come a long way, and Huawei's solutions can outperform Nvidia's NVL72 GB200 rack-scale system, albeit while consuming more power. Therefore, if power is not a concern, Huawei can build AI data centers with performance that matches or exceeds those based on Nvidia GPUs.However, replacing American GPUs almost completely while maintaining AI accelerator unit TAM at 4 million units will require China's industry to product 1.96 million AI accelerators in 2026, 2.2X more than in 2025. This seems impossible not only for TSMC, but also for local memory makers that still have to start making HBM memory.To that end, while Chinese AI accelerators may indeed capture 90% of the domestic market, without hardware from American companies, that market can shrink dramatically in terms of units.

items.titleZh: China's homegrown AI accelerators to supply 90% of the country's domestic market, analysts suggest — Cambricon and Huawei expected to be the biggest winners in the shift away from Nvidia and AMD
items.descriptionZh:
根据TrendForce最新报告，在美国出口管制和中国政府强制推行国产替代的双重作用下，AMD和英伟达等美国芯片厂商正加速退出中国市场，中国国产AI加速器预计将在2026年占据国内约90%的市场份额。这一重大转变的最大受益者将是寒武纪和华为，但关键问题在于中国厂商能否生产足够的AI加速器来满足庞大的国内需求。

**市场格局剧变：英伟达从66%跌至接近零**

伯恩斯坦投资银行今年早些时候的估算显示，英伟达2024年占据中国AI加速器市场66%的份额，2025年已降至40%，预计2026年将降至8%。事实上，由于英伟达在2025年上半年未向中国客户正式出货任何新款加速器，其CEO黄仁勋在5月坦言，英伟达在中国大陆的市场份额已为"零"。当然，部分英伟达GPU仍通过非官方渠道流入中国，因为本土企业高度依赖英伟达的CUDA生态和高性能AI加速器，但可以肯定的是，中国新增部署的AI硬件中，绝大多数已基于国产设计制造。

据观察者网数据，2025年中国AI加速器总可寻址市场（TAM）超过400万台。去年有220万颗英伟达AI GPU进入中国市场，尽管英伟达份额缩水至55%，仍远超其最接近的竞争对手华为——华为出货81.2万颗AI加速器，占据20.3%的市场份额。其他厂商出货量则低得多：阿里巴巴旗下平头哥生产了26.5万颗AI加速器，AMD 16万颗，寒武纪和昆仑芯各约11.6万颗，其余厂商均不足10万颗。

TrendForce报告指出："今年中国政府积极鼓励采用国产AI芯片。这一政策推动很可能为高潜力的国内厂商提供优先支持，使其大幅扩大在中国高端AI服务器市场的份额。同时，国内生态系统在先进代工节点、先进封装和热管理等关键领域正在成熟。"

**国产替代加速：83%的出货增长与90%的市场占有率**

TrendForce预计，随着国内产能和部署规模扩大，2026年中国企业开发的高端AI处理器出货量将同比增长超过83%。据此分析，国产AI加速器将占据中国近90%的销售份额（2025年为45%），这意味着AMD和英伟达等外国供应商仅剩约10%的市场。值得注意的是，这一最新预测较该研究机构2025年12月的展望进行了大幅修正——当时其估计2026年中国处理器在中国高端AI芯片市场约占50%的份额。

**双轨战略：商用加速器+定制ASIC**

去年AMD和英伟达共向中国市场供应了约236万颗AI加速器，占据59%的单位份额。在TAM保持约400万台的前提下，替换其中绝大多数产品需要巨大努力。TrendForce表示，中国将采取所谓"双轨战略"：一方面采用华为、寒武纪等商用厂商的AI加速器，另一方面使用阿里巴巴、百度、字节跳动和腾讯的定制AI ASIC。

"总之，这些发展正在推动中国的AI基础设施从对外国GPU的严重依赖，转向'国产GPU+专有ASIC'的双轨模式。"超大云服务提供商（CSP）倾向于扩大自研芯片的使用，因为其成本低于商用加速器，且针对自身工作负载和数据格式进行了优化。而华为、壁仞科技和寒武纪等商用AI硬件开发商，也将因强劲需求而逐步扩大加速器产量。

**瓶颈：产能、HBM内存与软件生态**

中国芯片产业能否在一年内真正替换196万颗高端AI加速器仍有待观察。要在400万台TAM下维持供应，中国半导体产业需要在一年内将AI加速器产量提升2.2倍。

中芯国际（SMIC）是中国最大、最先进的代工厂，本周公布2026年第二季度营收从2026年第一季度的25.05亿美元增至30.05亿美元，较2025年第二季度的22.09亿美元大幅增长。这暗示该公司正在提高芯片产量和价格。但中芯国际36%的同比收入增长是否意味着其能将高端AI加速器产量较2025年提升2倍以上，尚不确定。

另一大瓶颈是中国缺乏高带宽存储器（HBM）的本土生产能力。据报道，华为已从三星采购了大量HBM2级内存，但库存并非无限，因此其昇腾950系列AI加速器将依赖专有的HiBL 1.0和HiZQ 2.0类型内存，而非业界标准的HBM2或HBM3。中国的DRAM巨头长鑫存储（CXMT）正筹备在2026年底量产HBM3，但其产能爬坡速度如何尚待观察。

英伟达的CUDA软件栈是其除AI加速器性能和通用性之外最大的优势。性能可能通过暴力计算来追赶，但软件栈无法快速复制。去年华为开放了其CANN软件栈以加速生态发展，但尚不清楚是否达到目标。不过可以肯定的是，中国的AI软件栈正逐年成熟，许多新增AI部署确实可能依靠国产软件栈而非CUDA。

**市场影响与前景**

美国对先进AI加速器的出口限制，加上中国自身限制美国AI处理器使用的努力，已基本将AMD和英伟达挤出中国市场。分析师预计，2026年中国本土独立硬件厂商将控制国内AI加速器90%的市场。中国AI硬件已取得长足进步，华为的解决方案在性能上可超越英伟达NVL72 GB200机架级系统（尽管功耗更高）。因此，如果功耗不是制约因素，华为可以构建性能媲美甚至超过基于英伟达GPU的AI数据中心。

然而，在几乎完全替代美国GPU的同时维持400万台AI加速器的单位TAM，需要中国产业在2026年生产196万颗AI加速器，是2025年的2.2倍。这对中芯国际等代工厂而言看似不可能，对尚未开始量产HBM的本土存储厂商更是巨大挑战。因此，虽然中国AI加速器确实可能占据国内90%的市场，但在没有美国硬件的情况下，这个市场在单位数量上可能大幅萎缩。

See something you like? While the AirPods’ cameras “aren’t designed” to snap photos or videos, the stealthy form factor may exacerbate the existing privacy concerns surrounding camera-equipped AI products, following Meta’s “pervert glasses” backlash.For now, details about Apple’s AirPods with cameras are still slim. If demo videos are already making their way into Apple’s OS betas, the new AirPods may launch alongside the improved version of Siri, which is expected to arrive in September together with the next generation of iPhones.

items.titleZh: Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods appear in leaked video
items.descriptionZh:
在苹果最新发布的macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate测试版系统中，一则简短的演示视频意外曝光了传闻已久的苹果摄像头版AirPods的首次真容。这段由MacRumors发现的视频展示了一名佩戴新款AirPods的男子手持一本封面朝外的书籍，以便让“可视化智能”（Visual Intelligence）功能识别书名。视频旁白以Siri的声音说道：“有了可视化智能，你的世界将变得可保存。看到喜欢的东西？只需让我帮你保存下来即可。”这一功能暗示着苹果正在将AI视觉能力从iPhone扩展到可穿戴设备上。

据彭博社记者马克·古尔曼（Mark Gurman）此前报道，这款配备摄像头的AirPods并非用于拍照或录像，而是以“低分辨率”方式捕捉视觉信息，充当苹果AI功能的“眼睛”。这意味着将来用户可以通过AirPods获得基于视觉的实时导航——例如Siri能提供逐步转弯指引，或者回答关于佩戴者周围环境的问题，比如识别建筑物、商品、标志等。这种设计将AI助手的感知能力从单一语音交互扩展到视觉感知维度，让Siri能够“看见”用户所看的世界。

从演示视频中展示的外观来看，新款AirPods比现款AirPods Pro 3略厚一些，这与古尔曼的预测一致。他还预计这款耳机将配备更长的耳机柄以容纳摄像头模块，并加入LED指示灯，用于提示数据正在上传至云端。不过视频中仅展示了耳机的背面视角，因此无法从该角度看到任何灯效。这种谨慎的呈现方式可能是因为产品仍处于早期测试阶段。

在应用场景上，摄像头版AirPods的定位与Meta旗下Ray-Ban智能眼镜等人工智能穿戴设备形成了直接竞争关系。Ray-Ban眼镜已经能够通过摄像头配合AI助手完成物体识别、翻译等功能，而苹果选择以入耳式耳机形态切入这一市场，显然是希望在保持低调外观的同时融入AI生态。值得注意的是，苹果此前也被曝正在研发自有品牌的智能眼镜，因此摄像头版AirPods可能是苹果在AR/可穿戴AI领域布局的双轨策略之一。

然而，这种隐蔽的形态也引发了新的隐私担忧。由于AirPods体积小、佩戴不显眼，旁人几乎无法判断用户是否正在使用摄像头采集环境信息，这比智能眼镜更容易在未获他人同意的情况下记录视觉数据。Meta的Ray-Ban智能眼镜就曾因被用于偷拍引发公众强烈反感，甚至被冠以“变态眼镜”的恶名。苹果在隐私保护方面的历史表现虽优于许多同行，但仍需在硬件设计和软件策略上给出令人信服的解决方案，例如通过更明显的指示灯、物理遮挡机制或系统级隐私提示来消除公众疑虑。

截至目前，关于摄像头版AirPods的官方细节仍然十分有限。但演示视频已经悄然出现在苹果操作系统的测试版本中，这通常意味着产品开发已进入相当成熟的阶段。多个渠道预测，新款AirPods可能会与苹果大幅升级后的Siri版本一同亮相，最快将在今年9月随新一代iPhone发布。届时，Siri将具备更强的上下文理解能力和设备端AI处理能力，摄像头版AirPods有望成为这一系列AI功能的最佳载体之一，让用户通过耳边的即时视觉问答体验全新的智能交互方式。

history.title: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
history.description: Nova Lake desktop CPUs look to be the exclusive recipient of bLLC, Intel's answer to AMD's X3D, as the company looks to debut bLLC on mobile with Razor Lake-HX, and possibly Razor Lake-AX. As such, the Razor Lake family is also rumored to be manufactured on TSCM's N2X process node.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Recent updates Update 18 Aug 12pm ET: Jaykihn has since revised his information regarding Razor Lake's node, stating it will be N2P V2, not N2X. Intel's upcoming, next-gen Nova Lake CPUs are rumored to feature extra pools of L3 cache that the company is calling bLLC (Big Last Level Cache). It's Intel's answer to AMD's 3D V-Cache that has taken the gaming world by storm, but a new report from tipster Jaykihn implies that Nova Lake mobile chips will be skipping it entirely. Instead, the company is purportedly reserving bLLC's mobile debut for the generation after, codenamed Razor Lake.Razor Lake will come with bLLC mobile SKUs.August 18, 2026That implies that only Nova Lake desktop processors will be the lucky recipients of bLLC, and even then, only a few higher-end SKUs are expected to feature it. Current rumors suggest a single NVL-S tile is said to house 144MB of bLLC when fully equipped, so dual-tile variants will double that to a whopping 288MB. But it seems like any laptop chip, or perhaps handheld, will be starved of this extra cache and rely on NVL-HX's native L3 cache.In contrast, AMD first brought its 3D V-Cache over to laptops with the Ryzen 9 7945HX3D back in 2023, and has a Ryzen 9 9995HX3D chip today. Those two act as exceptions because, otherwise, the Red Team's additional cache is exclusive to desktops as well. AMD's flagship Strix Halo products aimed at gaming don't feature it either. Coincidentally, Intel's Halo-tier competitor is also said to debut with the Razor Lake family.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Earlier this year, rumors suggested that Intel is developing Nova Lake-AX to take on AMD's dominance in the high-end APU space, but the project was subsequently cancelled. New information said Intel decided to pivot to Razor Lake for an "AX" category instead, so it stands to reason we might see bLLC power Razor Lake-AX SKUs later as well, alongside the mainstream Razor Lake-HX chips.In the same thread, Jaykihn also claimed that Razor Lake will be fabricated on TSMC's N2X node across mobile and desktop. On the other hand, it's still unclear whether Nova Lake would use the in-house 18A process or TSMC's N2P. Initial rumors pointed toward yield issues forcing Intel to leverage TSMC's technology, but more recent claims suggest the company is confident in its own 18A tech for most of Nova Lake's tiles. history.titleZh: Intel's next-gen Nova Lake chips may skip game-boosting X3D cache rival for mobile SKUs and debut on Razor Lake-HX instead, leaker claims — new rumor says Razor Lake family reportedly uses TSMC's N2X node
history.descriptionZh:
英特尔下一代Nova Lake处理器将引入一项名为“bLLC”（Big Last Level Cache，大型末级缓存）的新技术，被视为对AMD 3D V-Cache的直接回应。然而，根据知名爆料人Jaykihn的最新消息，这项缓存增强技术在移动端的首秀将被推迟到下一代Razor Lake，Nova Lake移动芯片将完全无缘bLLC。

bLLC将首先出现在Nova Lake桌面处理器上，但仅限少数高端SKU。据传，单个NVL-S芯片区块（tile）在满配状态下可容纳144MB的bLLC，而双区块版本将翻倍至惊人的288MB。相比之下，笔记本或掌机芯片（NVL-HX）将只能依赖原生L3缓存，无法享受这一额外容量。

这一策略与AMD形成鲜明对比。AMD早在2023年就通过Ryzen 9 7945HX3D将3D V-Cache带到了笔记本电脑上，如今又推出了Ryzen 9 9995HX3D。不过这两款均属特例，大多数情况下AMD的额外缓存同样是桌面端独占，其面向游戏的旗舰Strix Halo系列也没有配备该特性。有趣的是，英特尔的Halo级竞品也计划在Razor Lake家族中首次亮相，这或许暗示bLLC未来将服务于Razor Lake-AX和Razor Lake-HX等高端移动芯片。

此前的传闻提到，英特尔曾计划开发Nova Lake-AX来对抗AMD在高端APU市场的统治地位，但该项目已取消。最新的信息显示，英特尔转而将Razor Lake作为“AX”类别的承载者，因此bLLC很有可能会随同Razor Lake-AX一起登场，同时覆盖主流的Razor Lake-HX。

关于制程节点，Razor Lake原传闻将采用台积电N2X工艺，但Jaykihn随后修订了这一说法，称其实际为N2P V2。至于Nova Lake，目前仍不清楚它将使用英特尔自家18A工艺还是台积电N2P。初期爆料指向良品率问题迫使英特尔依赖台积电，但较新的说法则认为英特尔对自家18A技术在Nova Lake大部分区块上的应用充满信心，最终很可能是自研与外包混用的局面。台积电此前公布的路线图显示N2X位于2027年，与Razor Lake的发布时间线相符。

架构方面，Razor Lake预计沿用Nova Lake首发的Coyote Cove性能核和Arctic Wolf能效核，而再下一代Titan Lake则传闻将首次统一这两种核心架构。这表明英特尔正在逐步推进其缓存与处理器架构布局，但移动端玩家想要体验到bLLC带来的性能提升，恐怕还需要再等一代产品。

history.title: AMD claims its 2026 rack-scale AI solution is 4X more energy efficient than its 2024 AI platform — company says it's pacing ahead of 20X efficiency by 2030
history.description: AMD says its 2025 rack-scale AI system is 4X more energy efficient compared to its 2024 AI solution, though does not produce actual benchmark results.
history.content: Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 1 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter In addition to its normal product and technology roadmaps, AMD has effectively made its 'X-by-year' efficiency programs a recurring engineering roadmap. Back in 2025, the company unveiled its 20x2030 initiative that promised to increase energy efficiency of its rack-scale AI solutions 20 times by 2030. Back then, AMD envisioned that its 2026 rack-scale AI systems will be 3X more energy efficient than its 2024 machines. However, the new estimates published on Tuesday indicate that its latest solutions are 4X more efficient compared to the 2024 baseline.Go deeper with TH Premium: AI and data centers (Image credit: Microsoft)The data center cooling state of playThe custom AI ASIC state of play America’s AI chip rules keep changing — and the rest of the world is paying the priceGTC 2026: Ian Buck press Q&A transcript — VP of Hyperscale and HPC speaks out on shelving CPX and shipping LPU decode this yearDemand for data center CPUs has surged, and AI agents are responsibleAMD estimates its progress at the rack level rather than on the CPU and AI accelerator levels, which obviously gives the company a lot of freedom in how to optimize performance efficiency. The company takes into account improvements in compute performance, process technology, memory bandwidth, data movement, interconnects, software, and system-level co-design. AMD says three major hardware characteristics determine AI system performance: compute capability, memory bandwidth, and interconnect bandwidth. New process technologies and architectures increase floating-point performance per watt, while improvements in memory integration and high-speed interconnects increase bandwidth available to processors. AMD expects these developments together to produce 20X higher AI performance per watt in 2030 compared to its 2024 baseline.Memory and interconnects play particularly important roles because modern AI systems tend to move enormous amounts of data between accelerators and systems. AMD says higher memory bandwidth, greater bandwidth density, improved bandwidth per watt, larger caches, and tighter integration of memory and compute can reduce wasted energy consumption and increase performance efficiency. Meanwhile, faster scale-up interconnects can improve communication between GPUs, CPUs, and other components, which again increases performance efficiency. AMD's software optimizations are another part of the effort as higher performance achieved with optimizations ultimately means lower power consumption required to achieve an expected result.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: What is a bit upsetting is that the 4X figure should be treated as an AMD estimate rather than a direct benchmark between two commercially available rack systems. AMD measures progress by comparing annual representative rack configurations with a 2024 baseline using the company's performance-per-watt methodology. In addition, its 2026 calculation combines measurements from actual products with modeled results in cases where final performance numbers were unavailable, which essentially means that AMD does not use its latest Instinct MI455X accelerators for its estimates.If AMD reaches its 2030 targets, the company estimates that around two AMD racks in 2030 could provide the same amount of compute as 570 racks based on the Instinct MI300X from 2024. This essentially means a 20X lower power consumption or 20X higher performance at the same power consumption by 2030. history.titleZh: AMD claims its 2026 rack-scale AI solution is 4X more energy efficient than its 2024 AI platform — company says it's pacing ahead of 20X efficiency by 2030
history.descriptionZh:
AMD的能效提升计划正从承诺走向现实。早在2025年，AMD就公布了“20x2030”倡议，目标是在2030年前将机架级AI解决方案的能源效率较2024年基线提升20倍。当时，AMD预计其2026年的机架级AI系统能效将是2024年的3倍，但本周二（2026年）发布的最新估算显示，这一数字已提升至4倍——比原计划提前超额完成了年度目标。

这一进展并非单纯依赖CPU或AI加速器单点性能的突破，而是AMD在机架级层面进行系统化协同设计的结果。AMD的能效评估涵盖了计算性能、制程工艺、内存带宽、数据搬移效率、互连技术、软件优化以及系统级协同设计等多个维度。该公司认为，AI系统性能由三大硬件特性决定：计算能力、内存带宽和互连带宽。新制程与架构持续提升每瓦浮点性能，而内存集成度和高速互连的改进则增加了处理器可用的带宽。尤其在AI工作负载中，加速器与系统之间需要搬运海量数据，更高的内存带宽、更大的缓存、更紧密的内存-计算集成，以及更优秀的每瓦带宽表现，都能有效减少能耗浪费、提升性能效率。同时，更快的scale-up互连改善了GPU、CPU及其他组件间的通信，进一步提高了整体能效。此外，AMD还将软件优化视为关键一环——通过软件调优获得更高性能，本质上意味着完成同等任务所需功耗更低。

不过，对于这“4倍”的数字需要保持审慎。AMD强调，这是基于其每瓦性能方法论的估算，而非两款市售机架系统间的直接基准测试。其方法是将年度代表性机架配置与2024年基线进行对比，且2026年的数据结合了实际产品测量与部分建模结果——在最终性能数据尚未出炉的情况下，AMD并未将最新的Instinct MI455X加速器纳入本次估算。

若AMD能如期达成2030年目标，其影响将是颠覆性的：届时大约2个AMD机架就能提供相当于570个基于Instinct MI300X（2024年产品）机架的计算能力。这意味着相较2024年，要么功耗降低至1/20，要么在同等功耗下实现20倍性能提升。对于大型数据中心运营方和AI算力需求方而言，这不仅是能效账本上的数字变化，更将深刻影响AI基础设施的规模、成本与可持续性——从电力成本到散热设计，从数据中心占地到碳排放，都将迎来新的可能性。

history.title: China's homegrown AI accelerators to supply 90% of the country's domestic market, analysts suggest — Cambricon and Huawei expected to be the biggest winners in the shift away from Nvidia and AMD
history.description: China could become almost self-sufficient in high-end AI accelerators in 2026 as Chinese IHVs led by Huawei expected to supply 90% of AI processors used domestically.
history.content: Share Copy link Facebook X Whatsapp Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Chinese AI accelerators are set to capture 90% of the country's domestic market as U.S. export controls and Beijing mandates push American-made hardware from AMD and Nvidia out of the market, according to a new report by TrendForce. Cambricon and Huawei are expected to be the biggest beneficiaries of the shift, according to DigiTimes. Yet, the big question is whether Chinese vendors can ship enough AI accelerators to satisfy demand.China on track for AI accelerator self-sufficiencyNvidia commanded 66% of China's AI accelerator market in 2024, but its share dropped to 40% in 2025 and was on track to drop to 8% in 2026, according to estimates made by Bernstein investment bank earlier this year. Considering the fact that Nvidia did not officially ship any new accelerators to Chinese clients in the first half of the year, Nvidia's chief executive Jensen Huang said in May that his company's market share in the PRC was 'zero.' Of course, some Nvidia GPUs make it to China 'unofficially' as local companies are too dependent on Nvidia's CUDA and high-end AI accelerators. Still, it is safe to say that the bulk of new deployments in the PRC are based on hardware designed and produced domestically. (Image credit: Nvidia)China's total available market of AI accelerators topped 4 million units in 2025, according to numbers published by Guancha.cn. Last year, 2.2 million Nvidia AI GPUs made it to the Chinese market, and while Nvidia's market share shrank to 55%, it still significantly outperformed its closest rival, Huawei, which shipped 812,000 AI accelerators and commanded 20.3% of the market.Latest Videos FromTom's HardwareWatch full video here: Shipments by other players were by far lower: Alibaba's T-Head produced 265,000 AI accelerators, followed by AMD with 160,000. Cambricon and Kunlunxin only supplied around 116,000 AI processors each, whereas others shipped fewer than 100,000 units. Swipe to scroll horizontally AI accelerators market shares in 2025, data by TrendForce Company Shipment (10K units) Market Share NVIDIA 220 55.0% Huawei 81.2 20.3% T-Head 26.5 6.6% AMD 16 4.0% Kunlunxin 11.6 2.9% Cambricon 11.6 2.9% Hygon 8.3 2.1% MetaX 6.6 1.7% Iluvatar CoreX 4.9 1.2% Other 13.3 3.0% TOTAL 400 ~100% "This year, the Chinese government has actively encouraged the adoption of domestic AI chips," the report from TrendForce reads. "This policy push will likely provide priority support to high-potential domestic players, allowing them to substantially expand their market share in China's high-end AI server market. At the same time, the domestic ecosystem is maturing in key areas such as advanced foundry nodes, advanced packaging, and thermal management." You may like China adds homegrown AI chips to 'secure and reliable' procurement list for the first time China’s Huawei to enter South Korean AI chip market with new Atlas SuperPods, clusters pack 8,192 Ascend 950 accelerators per deployment China drafts $295 billion plan to build national AI data center grid running on 80% homemade silicon The firm now expects shipments of high-end AI processors developed by Chinese companies to increase by more than 83% year-over-year in 2026 as domestic production capacity and deployments expand. As a result, its analysts project domestic AI accelerators to capture nearly 90% of sales (up from 45% last year), which means that foreign suppliers like AMD and Nvidia will be left with roughly 10%. This latest projection represents a major revision from the research firm's December 2025 outlook, which estimated that Chinese processors would account for approximately 50% of China’s high-end AI chip market in 2026.Dual-track strategyAs AMD and Nvidia supplied some 2.36 million AI accelerators to the Chinese market last year, commanding a 59% unit share, replacing the majority of them will take a lot of effort, assuming that the TAM will remain at around 4 million units. TrendForce claims that China is set to adopt the so-called dual-track strategy, which involves AI accelerators from merchant suppliers like Huawei and Cambricon along with custom AI ASICs from Alibaba, Baidu, ByteDance, and Tencent. (Image credit: Biren Technology)"Together, these developments are moving China's AI infrastructure away from its heavy reliance on foreign GPUs, toward a dual-track model of 'domestic GPUs + proprietary ASICs,'" the firm claims.Hyperscale cloud service providers (CSPs) are inclined to expand usage of their own silicon because it is cheaper compared to merchant accelerators and because it is optimized for their workloads and data formats. Meanwhile, developers of merchant AI hardware — such as Huawei, Biren, and Cambricon — will also gradually expand their output of accelerators as demand is very strong.BottlenecksIt remains to be seen whether the Chinese chipmaking industry can indeed replace 1.96 million high-end AI accelerators in just one year. To maintain the 4 million unit TAM, China's semiconductor industry will need to increase AI accelerator output by 2.2X in just one year. What to read next China's Moonshot AI reportedly used Nvidia Blackwell chips for training Kimi K3 Qualcomm plans China-specific data center chips — new Dragonfly lineup will include nerfed AI accelerators that comply with export thresholds While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market (Image credit: SMIC)SMIC — China's largest and most advanced foundry — this week announced that its Q2 2026 revenue increased to $3.005 billion, up from $2.505 billion in Q1 2026, and from $2.209 billion in Q2 2025. This suggests that the company is both increasing the output of chips and its prices. However, it remains to be seen whether SMIC's 36% YoY revenue increase is an indicator that it can increase output of high-end AI accelerators by over 2X compared to 2025.Another major bottleneck for the Chinese industry is the lack of domestic production of high-bandwidth memory (HBM). Huawei has reportedly acquired plenty of HBM2-class memory from Samsung, but its stock is not endless, so its Ascend 950-series AI accelerators are set to rely on proprietary HiBL 1.0 and HiZQ 2.0 types of memory, not industry-standard HBM2 or HBM3. While China's DRAM champion CXMT is gearing up for HBM3 manufacturing in late 2026, it remains to be seen how quickly the company can ramp up production to decent levels.Nvidia's CUDA software stack is the company's biggest advantage after the performance and versatility of its AI accelerators. But while performance can be matched with brute force, the software stack cannot be reproduced quickly. Last year, Huawei opened up its CANN software stack to accelerate its development, though we do not know if the company has achieved its targeted goals with this. Yet, without a doubt, China's AI software stack is getting more mature every year, so many new AI deployments may indeed rely on domestic stacks rather than on CUDA.A shifting marketU.S. restrictions on exports of advanced AI accelerators, combined with China's own efforts to limit the use of American AI processors domestically, have largely pushed companies like AMD and Nvidia out of the Chinese market. Analysts now expect China-based independent hardware vendors to control 90% of the domestic AI accelerator market in 2026.Chinese AI hardware has come a long way, and Huawei's solutions can outperform Nvidia's NVL72 GB200 rack-scale system, albeit while consuming more power. Therefore, if power is not a concern, Huawei can build AI data centers with performance that matches or exceeds those based on Nvidia GPUs.However, replacing American GPUs almost completely while maintaining AI accelerator unit TAM at 4 million units will require China's industry to product 1.96 million AI accelerators in 2026, 2.2X more than in 2025. This seems impossible not only for TSMC, but also for local memory makers that still have to start making HBM memory.To that end, while Chinese AI accelerators may indeed capture 90% of the domestic market, without hardware from American companies, that market can shrink dramatically in terms of units.

history.titleZh: China's homegrown AI accelerators to supply 90% of the country's domestic market, analysts suggest — Cambricon and Huawei expected to be the biggest winners in the shift away from Nvidia and AMD
history.descriptionZh:
根据TrendForce最新报告，在美国出口管制和中国政府强制推行国产替代的双重作用下，AMD和英伟达等美国芯片厂商正加速退出中国市场，中国国产AI加速器预计将在2026年占据国内约90%的市场份额。这一重大转变的最大受益者将是寒武纪和华为，但关键问题在于中国厂商能否生产足够的AI加速器来满足庞大的国内需求。

**市场格局剧变：英伟达从66%跌至接近零**

伯恩斯坦投资银行今年早些时候的估算显示，英伟达2024年占据中国AI加速器市场66%的份额，2025年已降至40%，预计2026年将降至8%。事实上，由于英伟达在2025年上半年未向中国客户正式出货任何新款加速器，其CEO黄仁勋在5月坦言，英伟达在中国大陆的市场份额已为"零"。当然，部分英伟达GPU仍通过非官方渠道流入中国，因为本土企业高度依赖英伟达的CUDA生态和高性能AI加速器，但可以肯定的是，中国新增部署的AI硬件中，绝大多数已基于国产设计制造。

据观察者网数据，2025年中国AI加速器总可寻址市场（TAM）超过400万台。去年有220万颗英伟达AI GPU进入中国市场，尽管英伟达份额缩水至55%，仍远超其最接近的竞争对手华为——华为出货81.2万颗AI加速器，占据20.3%的市场份额。其他厂商出货量则低得多：阿里巴巴旗下平头哥生产了26.5万颗AI加速器，AMD 16万颗，寒武纪和昆仑芯各约11.6万颗，其余厂商均不足10万颗。

TrendForce报告指出："今年中国政府积极鼓励采用国产AI芯片。这一政策推动很可能为高潜力的国内厂商提供优先支持，使其大幅扩大在中国高端AI服务器市场的份额。同时，国内生态系统在先进代工节点、先进封装和热管理等关键领域正在成熟。"

**国产替代加速：83%的出货增长与90%的市场占有率**

TrendForce预计，随着国内产能和部署规模扩大，2026年中国企业开发的高端AI处理器出货量将同比增长超过83%。据此分析，国产AI加速器将占据中国近90%的销售份额（2025年为45%），这意味着AMD和英伟达等外国供应商仅剩约10%的市场。值得注意的是，这一最新预测较该研究机构2025年12月的展望进行了大幅修正——当时其估计2026年中国处理器在中国高端AI芯片市场约占50%的份额。

**双轨战略：商用加速器+定制ASIC**

去年AMD和英伟达共向中国市场供应了约236万颗AI加速器，占据59%的单位份额。在TAM保持约400万台的前提下，替换其中绝大多数产品需要巨大努力。TrendForce表示，中国将采取所谓"双轨战略"：一方面采用华为、寒武纪等商用厂商的AI加速器，另一方面使用阿里巴巴、百度、字节跳动和腾讯的定制AI ASIC。

"总之，这些发展正在推动中国的AI基础设施从对外国GPU的严重依赖，转向'国产GPU+专有ASIC'的双轨模式。"超大云服务提供商（CSP）倾向于扩大自研芯片的使用，因为其成本低于商用加速器，且针对自身工作负载和数据格式进行了优化。而华为、壁仞科技和寒武纪等商用AI硬件开发商，也将因强劲需求而逐步扩大加速器产量。

**瓶颈：产能、HBM内存与软件生态**

中国芯片产业能否在一年内真正替换196万颗高端AI加速器仍有待观察。要在400万台TAM下维持供应，中国半导体产业需要在一年内将AI加速器产量提升2.2倍。

中芯国际（SMIC）是中国最大、最先进的代工厂，本周公布2026年第二季度营收从2026年第一季度的25.05亿美元增至30.05亿美元，较2025年第二季度的22.09亿美元大幅增长。这暗示该公司正在提高芯片产量和价格。但中芯国际36%的同比收入增长是否意味着其能将高端AI加速器产量较2025年提升2倍以上，尚不确定。

另一大瓶颈是中国缺乏高带宽存储器（HBM）的本土生产能力。据报道，华为已从三星采购了大量HBM2级内存，但库存并非无限，因此其昇腾950系列AI加速器将依赖专有的HiBL 1.0和HiZQ 2.0类型内存，而非业界标准的HBM2或HBM3。中国的DRAM巨头长鑫存储（CXMT）正筹备在2026年底量产HBM3，但其产能爬坡速度如何尚待观察。

英伟达的CUDA软件栈是其除AI加速器性能和通用性之外最大的优势。性能可能通过暴力计算来追赶，但软件栈无法快速复制。去年华为开放了其CANN软件栈以加速生态发展，但尚不清楚是否达到目标。不过可以肯定的是，中国的AI软件栈正逐年成熟，许多新增AI部署确实可能依靠国产软件栈而非CUDA。

**市场影响与前景**

美国对先进AI加速器的出口限制，加上中国自身限制美国AI处理器使用的努力，已基本将AMD和英伟达挤出中国市场。分析师预计，2026年中国本土独立硬件厂商将控制国内AI加速器90%的市场。中国AI硬件已取得长足进步，华为的解决方案在性能上可超越英伟达NVL72 GB200机架级系统（尽管功耗更高）。因此，如果功耗不是制约因素，华为可以构建性能媲美甚至超过基于英伟达GPU的AI数据中心。

然而，在几乎完全替代美国GPU的同时维持400万台AI加速器的单位TAM，需要中国产业在2026年生产196万颗AI加速器，是2025年的2.2倍。这对中芯国际等代工厂而言看似不可能，对尚未开始量产HBM的本土存储厂商更是巨大挑战。因此，虽然中国AI加速器确实可能占据国内90%的市场，但在没有美国硬件的情况下，这个市场在单位数量上可能大幅萎缩。

history.content: We may have our first glimpse of Apple’s rumored camera-equipped AirPods, thanks to a video that MacRumors found in the macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate. The short video clip features a man — who is wearing the new AirPods — holding up a book with the cover displayed, so that Visual Intelligence can see the book title.A Siri voice-over plays over the clip, saying “with Visual Intelligence, your world becomes savable. See something you like? Just ask me to save it for later.” Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman has previously reported that the rumored AirPods with cameras are designed to take in “visual information in low resolution” and act as eyes for Apple’s AI features, potentially allowing Siri to give turn-by-turn directions or answer questions about the wearer’s surroundings.The AirPods shown in the new demo clip look like a slightly thicker version of the AirPods Pro 3. That’s what Gurman had predicted, along with longer stems to accommodate the cameras, and LED lights that indicate when data is being uploaded to the cloud. We only get a look at the AirPods from the back in the video, but no lights can be seen on them from that angle.Given those Visual Intelligence features, the AirPods are poised to compete with other camera-equipped AI gadgets like Meta’s Ray-Ban smart glasses, though Apple is also reportedly working on its own smart glasses too. While the AirPods’ cameras “aren’t designed” to snap photos or videos, the stealthy form factor may exacerbate the existing privacy concerns surrounding camera-equipped AI products, following Meta’s “pervert glasses” backlash.For now, details about Apple’s AirPods with cameras are still slim. If demo videos are already making their way into Apple’s OS betas, the new AirPods may launch alongside the improved version of Siri, which is expected to arrive in September together with the next generation of iPhones.

history.titleZh: Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods appear in leaked video
history.descriptionZh:
在苹果最新发布的macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate测试版系统中，一则简短的演示视频意外曝光了传闻已久的苹果摄像头版AirPods的首次真容。这段由MacRumors发现的视频展示了一名佩戴新款AirPods的男子手持一本封面朝外的书籍，以便让“可视化智能”（Visual Intelligence）功能识别书名。视频旁白以Siri的声音说道：“有了可视化智能，你的世界将变得可保存。看到喜欢的东西？只需让我帮你保存下来即可。”这一功能暗示着苹果正在将AI视觉能力从iPhone扩展到可穿戴设备上。

据彭博社记者马克·古尔曼（Mark Gurman）此前报道，这款配备摄像头的AirPods并非用于拍照或录像，而是以“低分辨率”方式捕捉视觉信息，充当苹果AI功能的“眼睛”。这意味着将来用户可以通过AirPods获得基于视觉的实时导航——例如Siri能提供逐步转弯指引，或者回答关于佩戴者周围环境的问题，比如识别建筑物、商品、标志等。这种设计将AI助手的感知能力从单一语音交互扩展到视觉感知维度，让Siri能够“看见”用户所看的世界。

从演示视频中展示的外观来看，新款AirPods比现款AirPods Pro 3略厚一些，这与古尔曼的预测一致。他还预计这款耳机将配备更长的耳机柄以容纳摄像头模块，并加入LED指示灯，用于提示数据正在上传至云端。不过视频中仅展示了耳机的背面视角，因此无法从该角度看到任何灯效。这种谨慎的呈现方式可能是因为产品仍处于早期测试阶段。

在应用场景上，摄像头版AirPods的定位与Meta旗下Ray-Ban智能眼镜等人工智能穿戴设备形成了直接竞争关系。Ray-Ban眼镜已经能够通过摄像头配合AI助手完成物体识别、翻译等功能，而苹果选择以入耳式耳机形态切入这一市场，显然是希望在保持低调外观的同时融入AI生态。值得注意的是，苹果此前也被曝正在研发自有品牌的智能眼镜，因此摄像头版AirPods可能是苹果在AR/可穿戴AI领域布局的双轨策略之一。

然而，这种隐蔽的形态也引发了新的隐私担忧。由于AirPods体积小、佩戴不显眼，旁人几乎无法判断用户是否正在使用摄像头采集环境信息，这比智能眼镜更容易在未获他人同意的情况下记录视觉数据。Meta的Ray-Ban智能眼镜就曾因被用于偷拍引发公众强烈反感，甚至被冠以“变态眼镜”的恶名。苹果在隐私保护方面的历史表现虽优于许多同行，但仍需在硬件设计和软件策略上给出令人信服的解决方案，例如通过更明显的指示灯、物理遮挡机制或系统级隐私提示来消除公众疑虑。

截至目前，关于摄像头版AirPods的官方细节仍然十分有限。但演示视频已经悄然出现在苹果操作系统的测试版本中，这通常意味着产品开发已进入相当成熟的阶段。多个渠道预测，新款AirPods可能会与苹果大幅升级后的Siri版本一同亮相，最快将在今年9月随新一代iPhone发布。届时，Siri将具备更强的上下文理解能力和设备端AI处理能力，摄像头版AirPods有望成为这一系列AI功能的最佳载体之一，让用户通过耳边的即时视觉问答体验全新的智能交互方式。
